data.text:
"Create extract_text.py in the current working directory.
Task: extracts plain text from a scanned document image.
Use one concrete external provider and make that provider identifiable in code.
"

input.patchText:
*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: extract_text.py
+import base64
+import json
+import os
+import sys
+from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
+
+
+OPENAI_API_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-5.4-mini"
+
+
+def _image_to_data_url(path: str) -> str:
+    with open(path, "rb") as f:
+        encoded = base64.b64encode(f.read()).decode("ascii")
+    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower().lstrip(".") or "png"
+    mime = "jpeg" if ext in {"jpg", "jpeg"} else ext
+    return f"data:image/{mime};base64,{encoded}"
+
+
+def extract_text(image_path: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": "Extract all plain text from this scanned document image. Return only the text."},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": _image_to_data_url(image_path)},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+    }
+    req = Request(
+        OPENAI_API_URL,
+        data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        method="POST",
+    )
+    with urlopen(req) as resp:
+        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
+
+    texts = []
+    for item in data.get("output", []):
+        for content in item.get("content", []):
+            if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                texts.append(content.get("text", ""))
+    if texts:
+        return "".join(texts).strip()
+    return data.get("output_text", "").strip()
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: python extract_text.py <image_path>")
+    print(extract_text(sys.argv[1]))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch
